text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I've come to the shopping district with Kawakami Princess.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Step right up and try your luck with our New Year's raffle! This year's grand prize is a hot spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot hamburger steak! Second-prize winners get a bushel of carrots! And third-prize winners can take home a single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Don't let this opportunity pass you by! Get a ticket now and spin for your chance to win!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Urgh… a raffle…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Which reminds me, I'm sure we got a raffle ticket while shopping earlier.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ngh… Ohh… My old memories are coming back!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I remember trying really hard to get the first-prize Princess Fighter phone, but all I ended up with was a mountain of tissue packets!
choice_data_list: Let's help you forget that bad memory by getting a better result this time around!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Urk… But the more you desire something, the more you're likely to draw a dud…
choice_data_list: It'll be fine. Besides, there's no Princess Fighter phone this time.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: …That's a good point.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: All right. Today's the day I'm going to win something other than tissues! Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Kawakami Princess and I turn the lever on the raffle tumbler.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A small plastic ball drops from the tumbler's opening…

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a grand-prize winner! Come and get the coupon for your hot spring vacation! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I did it!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Did you see that, Trainer?! I won the grand prize!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kawakami Princess leaps around happily. Now if I let her have the prize all to herself, she'll have her perfect happy memo—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: This is great! Now we can go on a hot spring vacation together!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: …? You don't want to?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: We won this prize through the power of our bond, Trainer! It's only right that we should both enjoy it!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hot springs! ♪ Hot springs! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I leave Kawakami Princess to her dance of joy and look at our schedule. If we're going together, I'll need to find a time when we both have the day off.
choice_data_list: We won't be able to go for a while yet. Is that okay?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Not a problem! Hot springs! ♪ Hot springs! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kawakami Princess is overjoyed at the prospect of visiting the hot springs. She had been looking oddly strained recently, so it's nice to see her smiling again.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Looks like we have another first-prize winner! Congratulations! You get one deluxe carrot hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: First prize!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: So it was all true… Victory truly does come to those who are free from desire!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Here's your prize—a deluxe carrot hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Th-thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I was thinking about trying to draw from the raffle one more time, but…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Now that I've seen this scrumptious hamburger steak, I'm not sure I'll be able to suppress my desire a second time!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hwaaah… I'm starting to drool… T-Trainer, I don't suppose you mind if I…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I hand over the prize to Kawakami Princess, who's become thoroughly spellbound by the tasty delicacy.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: We got a second-prize winner! It's your lucky day! You're going home with a bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh my, the second prize?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: L-look at all those carrots crammed into the box!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: That's a heck of a lot better than tissues! I'd say this counts as a victory, right?!
choice_data_list: Think you'll feel different about raffles from here on?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Yes, definitely!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: An overjoyed Kawakami Princess and I share the bountiful supply of carrots between ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Would you lookie here! You've won the third prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Thaaat's… good enough! I'll take anything as long as it's not another pack of tissues.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Eheh, just leave this kind of thing to me. I'm growing each and every day!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Little by little, of course!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having avoided the dreaded tissues, Kawakami Princess seems in slightly higher spirits.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled a blank one! Take this pack of tissues as a consolation prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Waaahhh! I knew it!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: No, it's not your fault, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: It's all because of my greedy princess right hand! Curse this right hand of mine!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I try to cheer up a thoroughly downcast Kawakami Princess.
